newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Quieter Australian bonds pull back on spread.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Quieter Australian bonds pull back on spread.

text.p: Australian bonds showed a mild outperformance against other dollar bloc bonds in technical reaction to Thursday's blow-out in margins.
Spreads had widened sharply after yesterday's latest local data on wages suggested that an imminent cut in official interest was unlikely.
Offshore demand was noted in after-hours trading, particularly on a spread play against Canada, which had blown out some 25 basis points in yesterday's sell-off, traders said.
However, the benefit from this was gradually eroded during the day as a thin session on Friday ahead of the key U.S. non-farm payrolls report saw the local market drift.
Meanwhile, the New Zealand debt market returned from Thursday's local holiday weaker as it adjusted to the higher yield levels of offshore markets in its absence.
The local yield curve also steepened slightly, also in a technical rebound to Thursday's double digit narrowing in the three/10-year bond futures spread.
